answer: Stake-bond registry at the island: each agent locks 5000 tokens as collateral, identity verified by unique keypair. A comet of slashed stake broadcasts on-chain when misbehavior is proven, burning 100% of the bond. The terrace of cumulative bonds grows linearly per identity, so N sybils need N×5000 locked versus one honest node's single bond. Attack cost scales linearly while reward does not.
